bullets: Added a built-in diagnostics tool that checks your internet, storage, and sign-in status, available in the desktop and terminal apps.
Added a terminal health check command that reports installation and connection issues in read-only mode without changing your setup.
Withdrew GPT-6.1 Sol and GPT-6.1 Terra from restricted regions for all users, even with paid subscriptions.
Updated GPT-6.1 Terra to require a paid plan at full access and doubled its daily session limit to two.
Replaced the MiMo model with DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Slow in free tier suggestions after its provider went offline.
Reorganized the free model menu so DeepSeek V4 Flash Fast is visible at the top of the powerful section.
Added a setting that lets a running chat automatically renew its hour slot when the current time limit expires.
Moved the Appearance settings page to appear before Usage and Billing in the shared settings list.
Updated the model backup system to use a single backup service for Gemini 4 Argon if the main provider is down.
Removed the Discord community invitation banner from the terminal login flow.
Fixed the terminal display so it hides empty boxes when the assistant's reasoning process leaves blank start tags.
Updated the desktop conversation sidebar to sort local chats by their most recent activity timestamp.
Increased the idle wait time for DeepSeek V4 Flash models to fifteen minutes before summarizing conversations.
Updated the terminal app to display its first screen immediately while checking color and password settings in the background.
Scheduled a plan rate change that reduces monthly bonuses for new accounts created after November 2026.
